example_parity_even_weak_threshold: Each of the four new vectorlike weak doublet fermion pairs has degenerate supersymmetric scalar partners at its own mass, frozen flavour backgrounds and no additional finite nonuniversal threshold. The five new color states are Dirac fermions, with no active scalar partners in the primary matching. This is a conditional threshold EFT.
gauge_scope: One-loop positive thresholds and R1698 soft conversion. Numerical bounds on protecting the flavor interval refer to the four extra weak levels; the new colored thresholds still alter charged running and require a separate charged refit.
